A pipe bursts at 9 PM.

Most businesses lose that call to voicemail and never see the caller again.

Here's the branch logic behind an after-hours line that captures the call: one text asks if it's an emergency, then routes the reply two different ways in real time. No dispatcher needed after midnight.
